extracted.intended_audience: Readers of Popular Science Monthly; educated general public and amateur scientists interested in geology, earth history, and physical science history.
extracted.subtask_description: A multi-part Popular Science Monthly magazine piece containing an illustrated essay on glacial geology (erratics, drift, roches moutonnees), a reflective poem, and a historical review of the development of the dynamical theory of heat. Intended as accessible science exposition for a lay/educated audience.
